title: Action Cable & Pub/Sub
intro: Action Cable integrates WebSockets into Rails, allowing the server to push updates to connected clients without polling. The architecture uses channels (analogous to controllers), streams (named pub/sub topics), and the Redis adapter for pub/sub across multiple Puma processes. Turbo Streams in Rails 7+ are built on top of Action Cable and represent the modern way to push real-time DOM updates. This page covers the full channel lifecycle (subscribed, unsubscribed, receive), Redis pub/sub vs polling vs SSE trade-offs, broadcasting from a Sidekiq job to connected clients, authentication in the connection handshake, and scaling Action Cable — the sticky-session requirement when multiple app servers are behind a load balancer and Redis is the pub/sub hub.
